items.source:
An origin that is used to select data from. selection origins are used with paths to define where a path is
anchored.
items.translation: 用于从中选择数据的源。选择源与路径配合使用，以定义路径的锚点位置。

items.source:
Returns the path in dot-path notation to identify the origin uniquely. Entities typically return their entity
name while joins return a dot-path.
items.translation: 返回用于唯一标识源点的点路径表示法中的路径。实体通常返回其实体名称，而连接则返回点路径。
